question:

At most one of them contains a small surface defect such as a scratch, cut, crack or thread. Which region contains the defect?
(A) [0.8038, 0.3349, 0.9238, 0.4549]
(B) [0.4884, 0.5421, 0.6084, 0.6621]
(C) [0.2979, 0.4122, 0.4179, 0.5322]
(D) No defect in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
